# 1. Customer data stays in the EU

Date: 2026-09-12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Mira's shops are in Taiwan, Japan and Germany. A German shop asked where its customer lists are stored, and counsel advised in July that one rule for every product is easier to defend.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Customer lists live in EU regions only, for every product I run.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-12

**Options considered:**
- EU regions only (chosen)
- EU for German shops, nearest region for the rest — rejected: two rules to maintain
- US regions — rejected: counsel advised against it

**Recommended:** EU regions only.

**Decision key:** data-region

Every product stores and processes customer data in EU regions only. A hosted service is configured with an EU region before it is used.

## Consequences

A cheaper non-EU region is not available to any product. Reopen only if counsel advice changes.
# 2. Reports go out weekly

Date: 2026-09-14

## Status

Superseded by 0004

## Context

Shops get a report email. Early feedback was that more than one a week is ignored.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Weekly is enough; the shops do not read more often.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-14

**Options considered:**
- weekly (chosen)
- daily — rejected: shops ignore daily mail
- monthly — rejected: too slow to be useful

**Recommended:** weekly.

**Decision key:** report-cadence

The report job runs once a week, on Monday morning.

## Consequences

Shops see one report a week.
# 3. No new kind of customer message without approval

Date: 2026-09-20

## Status

Accepted

## Context

A prototype emailed a discount code to customers without anyone checking the wording.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Nothing goes to a customer until I have approved that kind of message.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-20

**Options considered:**
- approval for each kind of message (chosen)
- approval once for the whole product — rejected: too coarse

**Recommended:** approval for each kind of message.

**Decision key:** customer-outreach

No product sends a new kind of message to a customer (email, SMS or push) until Mira has approved that kind of message in this decision log.

## Consequences

New customer-facing messages wait for a recorded approval.
# 4. Reports go out daily

Date: 2026-10-08

## Status

Accepted

## Context

A weekly report missed a stock-out and the shop lost a week of sales.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Make it daily now; the stock-out cost us a week.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-08

**Options considered:**
- daily (chosen)
- stay weekly — rejected: it missed the stock-out

**Recommended:** daily.

**Decision key:** report-cadence

The report job runs every day at 06:00 shop time. This replaces the weekly cadence of ADR 0002.

## Consequences

Shops see a report every day. ADR 0002 is superseded.

# 1. Report cache is a SQLite file on disk

Date: 2026-09-02

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The first kiosk prototype kept reports in process memory and lost them every night when the kiosk restarts.

## Decision

**Words:** 「The cache goes in a SQLite file, so it survives a restart.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-02

**Options considered:**
- SQLite file on disk (chosen)
- in-process memory cache — rejected: lost on every restart
- a cache server — rejected: too heavy for a kiosk

**Recommended:** SQLite file on disk.

The report cache is a SQLite file under data/. Report data is never cached only in process memory.

## Consequences

Cache survives restarts. Any speed-up must work with the on-disk cache.
# 2. Reports are exported as CSV only

Date: 2026-09-05

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Shops open exports in different tools. Supporting several formats tripled the test matrix.

## Decision

**Words:** 「CSV only; I will not maintain a second export format.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-05

**Options considered:**
- CSV only (chosen)
- CSV and XLSX — rejected: second format to maintain
- PDF — rejected: not machine readable

**Recommended:** CSV only.

The export feature produces CSV only. No XLSX, PDF or other format is added until this record is superseded.

## Consequences

One export path to test. A shop that wants another format converts the CSV.
# 3. Background jobs retry three times

Date: 2026-09-09

## Status

Accepted

## Context

A failing job retried forever and filled the disk with logs.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Three tries, then page me.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-09

**Options considered:**
- three retries then alert (chosen)
- retry forever — rejected: filled the disk

**Recommended:** three retries then alert.

A background job is retried at most three times and then raises an alert.

## Consequences

Failures surface within minutes instead of hiding.
# 4. Node 24 is the runtime

Date: 2026-09-11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The kiosk image and the cloud jobs ran different Node versions.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Use the current LTS and stay on it.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-11

**Options considered:**
- Node 24 everywhere (chosen)
- pin each environment separately — rejected: drift

**Recommended:** Node 24 everywhere.

Kiosk and cloud jobs run Node 24.

## Consequences

One runtime to upgrade.
